title: Role levels

schemaVersion.description: Version of this file's layout. It changes only when the layout does.

gameBuild.description: Steam build id the data was extracted from.

id.description: Role id: the game's role tag without the `Meta.Role.` prefix: Infantry, Support, Medic, Recon, Pilot or Driver. The same ids as `unlock.role` in items.json.

xpResource.description: The game's attribute that holds the role's XP, without the `Attribute.Meta.` prefix, for example `XP.Role.Infantry`.

xp.description: Total role XP needed to reach this level, counted from zero (level 0 needs 0). The game's progress display reads `current XP / next level XP`, so the values are totals, not per-level costs.

levels.description: Every level from 0 up, sorted by level.

items.description: The XP a role needs for each level.

description: Role mastery: the XP needed for each level of each role. Items unlock at a role level (`unlock` in items.json), so this turns a level gate into an amount of XP. The overall Wardog (career) level, which gates some items up to level 150, has no table of its own: the game's text says all role levels combine into it, without giving the formula.
